title: Diploma In Health And Social Care Management (Level 4)
description: Gain the essential knowledge and skills to lead and support health and social care services effectively and ethically.
longDescription: This Level 4 Diploma in Health and Social Care Management is designed for individuals aspiring to contribute meaningfully to healthcare service delivery. The programme provides a strong foundation in managing resources, supporting care practices, and ensuring compliance with professional standards. Learners will explore key themes such as communication, health and safety, and equality and diversity. Emphasis is placed on developing critical thinking and effective leadership in health and social care environments. The course equips participants with both academic and workplace-relevant skills to advance in the care sector.
courseDetails: Each module consists of 40 guided learning hours of material with an additional 30-50 hours worth of optional materials which comprise of recommended exercises, recommended readings and internet resources. Within the modules are self-testing exercises. You must take care in answering these. Although they are not marked nor do they count towards your final assessment, the marking is tested against your scoring on the final assessment to check for consistency of score. This diploma is ideal for individuals currently working in or seeking to enter health and social care roles with managerial responsibilities. The curriculum balances theoretical understanding with practical application to enhance professional effectiveness. Modules are aligned with current industry standards and regulatory frameworks. Students will develop communication, assessment, and resource management capabilities essential for high-quality care delivery.

entry: For entry into Level 4 Diploma in Health And Social Care Management, learners must possess the following:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Result can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Result. (This is assessed on a case by case basis)
* Learner must be 18 years or older at the start of the Course.
* Mature Learners (21 years or older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.
